rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun and knowledge compounded; nominative singular neuter
compound indicating abiding or being situated in Sadāśiva

items.question: In which reality is this knowledge declared to be established?
premises: The verse identifies a specific knowledge.
The goddess Maheśānī is directly addressed.
That knowledge is described as established in Sadāśiva.
uncertainties: The grammatical role of etajjñānaṃ as subject or topic is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: O Maheśānī, this knowledge is established in Sadāśiva.
